Kukua Messages.Title: welcome
Kukua Messages.Text: Hello! I'm Kukua, your Corbit X guide. Between now and go-live on Monday 1 February 2027, I'll help you discover what Corbit X means for our customers, branches, and teams. Let's get started.

Kukua Messages.Title: journeyIntro
Kukua Messages.Text: Six stops, six guides. Use the arrows or swipe, and I'll tell you what each one is about.

Kukua Messages.Title: start
Kukua Messages.Text: Ready? Our first stop is all about account numbers. Let's go!

Kukua Messages.Title: finish
Kukua Messages.Text: You've reached the end of the journey. Well done! Come back any time to refresh your knowledge.

Kukua Messages.Title: closing
Kukua Messages.Text: Corbit X is more than a system. It's a journey we are taking together. Keep learning, stay informed, and let's prepare for the future.

Kukua Messages.Title: chatGreeting
Kukua Messages.Text: Hi, I'm Kukua! Ask me anything about Corbit X, or tap one of the questions below.

Kukua Messages.Title: chatFallback
Kukua Messages.Text: Good question! I don't have an answer for that one yet. Try one of the suggested questions, or check the guide, ask your champion, and log a Command Centre ticket if you are still stuck.

Section Intros.Title: highlights
Section Intros.Text: Look how far we've come together! Our simulation score rose from 51% to 93.4%, and confidence has nearly doubled.

Section Intros.Title: changes
Section Intros.Text: Big changes are coming, and they're good ones. Here's what Corbit X means for our customers.

Section Intros.Title: staff
Section Intros.Text: Corbit X makes our work simpler too. Tap 'Today' and 'With Corbit X' to see the difference.

Section Intros.Title: training

Section Intros.Title: next

Journey Stages.Title: Understanding the Transition
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Customers may have questions about account numbers. Corbit X will introduce changes designed to support a smoother banking experience. This guide helps you confidently support every customer conversation.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: Here's how to help a customer who arrives with their old account number.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: Old account numbers will continue to be accepted for more than six months after go-live. The new account number has 13 digits, and a customer's CIF gains “00” in front.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Look up | Find the new account number in Corbit X using the process covered in training.
Serve | Serve the customer and support their transaction.
Share | Share the new account number at every interaction. Encourage its use next time.
Journey Stages.PanelNote: Guidance on printing new account numbers will follow.
Journey Stages.KeyMessage: Look it up. Share it. Keep banking moving.

Journey Stages.Title: Chequebook Transition
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Chequebook updates can raise customer questions. Understanding the process ensures we provide the right guidance and support.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: My quick tips for cheques that carry old account numbers.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: Cheques bearing old account numbers are accepted for six months (182 days) after go-live, until 2 August 2027, subject to the usual checks. After that date, these cheques will no longer be accepted.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Accept | Accept old-number cheques until 2 August 2027, subject to the usual checks.
Encourage | Encourage customers to request new chequebooks early.
Explain | Explain the transition clearly and help customers with their request.

Journey Stages.Title: Supporting Special Cases
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Some situations require special attention. Explore practical ways to help customers and identify available alternatives.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: Some older chequebooks can't come with us. Here's how to support those customers with care.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: Affected chequebooks recorded in the system more than five years ago will not be migrated to Corbit X and can no longer be used. These customers have been notified.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Explain | Explain the position with care.
Help | Help the customer access funds through an approved alternative.
Assist | Assist with a new chequebook where required.
Journey Stages.KeyMessage: Do not turn the customer away. Help them find a solution.

Journey Stages.Title: Operational Preparedness
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Preparation drives success. Learn how readiness activities help teams operate confidently during key milestones.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: Here's what happens on the Sunday before go-live, and your part in it.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: On Sunday 31 January 2027, the day before go-live, BOSs will open the branch day. All branch staff will take part in live transaction and channel checks.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Friday 29 January | Finish all transactions by the 2:00pm cut-off, balance cash and vault, clear suspense and run the final end of day.
Test | On Sunday, test deposits, branch transactions, ATMs, the mobile app and other instructed channels.
Real funds | These are real transactions with real funds. Follow controls and report issues promptly.
Don't close | Do not close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday.
Continue | Continue the same branch day into Monday 1 February. Run end of day at the close of business on Monday.

Journey Stages.Title: Customer Experience First
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Technology will evolve, but our commitment to exceptional customer service remains unchanged.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: My favourite service tips for go-live day. Let your smile lead!
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: Our upgrade should improve the customer experience. Make every customer feel welcome, valued and supported.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Smile & serve | Bring the same warmth, patience and care to every interaction. Keep customers informed and reassured.
Listen & pause | If a customer complains, listen calmly. If you are unsure, pause and check before answering.
Check quickly | Consult the relevant internal team for the information you need to serve the customer well.
Use the repository | Find the relevant guidebook or procedure. The information is at your fingertips, so use it.
Journey Stages.KeyMessage: Smile. Check. Serve. Never let a system change become a reason to turn a customer away.

Journey Stages.Title: Keeping Business Moving
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Business continues while we prepare for change. Discover how we maintain excellent service and support customers throughout the journey.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: Account opening pauses for a short while, but our welcome never does. Here's how.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: During the static data freeze in the week before go-live and the first three days after go-live (Monday 1 to Wednesday 3 February), account opening is unavailable in Flexcube 11.1 and Corbit X.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Start | Start in Newgen. Collect all required documents.
Receive | Receive deposits through the designated GL. Record and monitor every deposit.
Finalise | Finalise from Thursday 4 February and provide account numbers.
Journey Stages.PanelSay: We are upgrading our systems to serve you better. We can start your application now. Your account number will be provided from Thursday after the upgrade.
Journey Stages.KeyMessage: Never turn away an account-opening request because of the upgrade.

FAQs.Title: What is Corbit X?
FAQs.Answer: Corbit X is our new core banking platform. It replaces Flexcube 11.1 and will power how we serve customers in our branches and across our channels.
FAQs.Keywords: what is corbit x system platform

FAQs.Title: Why are we moving to Corbit X?
FAQs.Answer: We're moving to Corbit X to prepare for the future of banking: a modern platform that helps us serve customers better and work more simply as a team.

FAQs.Title: How will customers benefit?
FAQs.Answer: Quicker service at the counter, a 360-degree customer view at the teller point, faster credit and salary processing, statements for the last 12 months straight from Corbit X and a more secure 13-digit account number. While we transition, old account numbers keep working for more than six months after go-live, and cheques with old numbers are accepted until 2 August 2027.

FAQs.Title: What changes for branches?
FAQs.Answer: A few things to know: new account numbers (look them up in Corbit X and share them), cheque and chequebook changes, a short pause in account opening around go-live, and live checks on Sunday 31 January 2027. Each one has a stop on the journey.
FAQs.Keywords: branch branches change changes staff operations

FAQs.Title: Where can I find guides?
FAQs.Answer: Right here! There are six guides on my journey. Tap 'View Guide' on any stop to see the full poster. You will also find guides, staff FAQs and how-to videos on the Corbit X portal on the info portal.
FAQs.Keywords: guide guides poster posters find where

FAQs.Title: Who can I contact for support?
FAQs.Answer: Check the guide or FAQ first, then ask your champion or team lead. If you are still stuck, log a Command Centre ticket with a screenshot, and keep the customer updated while you wait. Contact details for the Command Centre will be listed here.
FAQs.Keywords: contact support help who phone email

FAQs.Title: Will old account numbers still work?
FAQs.Answer: Yes. Old account numbers will continue to be accepted for more than six months after go-live. The new account number has 13 digits, and the CIF keeps the same number with “00” added in front. Look up the new number in Corbit X and share it with the customer.
FAQs.Keywords: old account number numbers still work accepted

FAQs.Title: Can we open accounts during the upgrade?
FAQs.Answer: Account opening pauses during the static data freeze and the first three days after go-live (Monday 1 to Wednesday 3 February). Start the application in Newgen, receive deposits through the designated GL, and finalise from Thursday 4 February.
FAQs.Keywords: open opening account new freeze newgen

FAQs.Title: How do statements work in Corbit X?
FAQs.Answer: Statements for the last 12 months come straight from Corbit X. Older statements, back to when the account was opened, come from stored backup.

FAQs.Title: What about cheques?
FAQs.Answer: Cheques with old account numbers are accepted for six months (182 days) after go-live, until 2 August 2027, subject to the usual checks. Chequebooks recorded more than five years ago won't be migrated, so help those customers find an approved alternative. Encourage everyone to reorder early.

FAQs.Title: What happens on the Sunday before go-live?
FAQs.Answer: On Sunday 31 January 2027, BOSs open the branch day and all branch staff run live transaction and channel checks with real funds. Don't close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday; continue into Monday and run end of day at close of business.
FAQs.Keywords: sunday checks testing test weekend live

FAQs.Title: When does Corbit X go live?
FAQs.Answer: Corbit X goes live on Monday 1 February 2027, in every branch and department at the same time. The final cut-off on the current system is Friday 29 January at 2:00pm.
FAQs.Keywords: when date go-live golive live start monday february 2027 cut-off

FAQs.Title: How do I read the new account number?
FAQs.Answer: It has 13 digits. Digits 1 and 2 are the currency (00 cedi, 01 dollar, 02 pound, 03 euro). Digit 3 is the customer type (1 individual, 2 non-individual, 3 banks and others). Digits 4 to 11 are a serial number, and digits 12 and 13 are check digits.
FAQs.Keywords: account number new 13 digit digits currency customer type format read cif

FAQs.Title: What if someone asks a customer for their OTP?
FAQs.Answer: The bank never asks for a PIN, password or OTP, and you must never share your login. Tell the customer, and report anything suspicious to Fraud and Risk.
FAQs.Keywords: otp pin password fraud scam suspicious login share

Hub FAQs.Title: When does Corbit X go live?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Corbit X goes live on Monday 1 February 2027, in every branch and department at the same time. The final cut-off on the current system is Friday 29 January at 2:00pm.

Hub FAQs.Title: Will customers' old account numbers still work after go-live?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Yes. Old account numbers will continue to be accepted for more than six months after go-live. The new account number has 13 digits, and the CIF gains “00” in front. Look up the new number in Corbit X using the process covered in training, serve the customer, and share the new number so they use it next time.

Hub FAQs.Title: Can customers still use cheques that show their old account number?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Yes, for six months (182 days) after go-live, until 2 August 2027, subject to the usual checks. After that date these cheques will no longer be accepted, so encourage customers to request new chequebooks early.

Hub FAQs.Title: What about chequebooks recorded more than five years ago?
Hub FAQs.Answer: These chequebooks will not be migrated to Corbit X and can no longer be used. Affected customers have been notified. Explain the position with care, help them access funds through an approved alternative, and assist with a new chequebook where required.

Hub FAQs.Title: Can we open new accounts during the upgrade?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Account opening is unavailable in Flexcube 11.1 and Corbit X during the static data freeze (the week before go-live) and for the first three days after go-live (Monday 1 to Wednesday 3 February). Start the application in Newgen, receive deposits through the designated GL, and finalise from Thursday 4 February. Never turn a customer away.

Hub FAQs.Title: What happens on the Sunday before go-live?
Hub FAQs.Answer: On Sunday 31 January 2027, BOSs will open the branch day and all branch staff take part in live transaction and channel checks: deposits, branch transactions, ATMs, the mobile app and other instructed channels. These are real transactions with real funds. Do not close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday; continue into Monday and run end of day at close of business.

Hub FAQs.Title: What should I do if I'm not sure how to answer a customer?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Pause and check before answering. Consult the relevant internal team, or find the guidebook or procedure in the repository. Never let a system change become a reason to turn a customer away.

Hub FAQs.Title: Will new account numbers be printed for customers?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Guidance on printing new account numbers will follow. Until then, look up and share the new number at every interaction.

Hub FAQs.Title: How do I read the new account number?
Hub FAQs.Answer: It has 13 digits. Digits 1 and 2 are the currency (00 cedi, 01 dollar, 02 pound, 03 euro). Digit 3 is the customer type (1 individual, 2 non-individual, 3 banks and others). Digits 4 to 11 are a serial number, and digits 12 and 13 are check digits. Always add “00” in front of an existing CIF.

Hub FAQs.Title: What should I do if I'm stuck?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Check the repository guide or FAQ, then ask your champion or team lead. If you are still stuck, log a Command Centre ticket with a screenshot, and update the customer while you wait.

Hub FAQs.Title: What if someone asks a customer for their OTP?
Hub FAQs.Answer: The bank never asks for a PIN, password or OTP, and you must never share your login. Tell the customer, and report anything suspicious to Fraud and Risk.

Project Updates.Body: Guidance on printing new account numbers for customers will follow. Watch this space.

Key Dates.Title: Static data migration
Key Dates.Body: Customer and account data moves to Corbit X.

Key Dates.Title: Data validation begins
Key Dates.Body: Every record checked and confirmed, Wednesday 13 to Friday 15 January.

Key Dates.Title: Financial validation
Key Dates.Body: Balances checked to the last pesewa.

Key Dates.Title: Business simulation
Key Dates.Body: Migration plus a full day of business replay.

Key Dates.Title: Final cut-off, 2:00pm
Key Dates.Body: Last day on the current system. Balance cash and vault, clear suspense and run the final end of day.

Key Dates.Title: Sunday live checks
Key Dates.Body: BOSs open the branch day; all staff run live transaction and channel checks. Do not close the day or run end of day.

Key Dates.Title: Corbit X go-live
Key Dates.Body: Arrive by 7:00am. Continue Sunday's branch day; run end of day at close of business.

Key Dates.Title: Account opening resumes
Key Dates.Body: Finalise pending applications and provide account numbers.

Key Dates.Title: Old-number cheques end
Key Dates.Body: Six months (182 days) after go-live: cheques bearing old account numbers are no longer accepted.
